text: The sample standard deviation (sigma) of 9.11153 degrees for the pitch measurement indicates how much the pitch values from your IMU module vary around the average pitch value. A larger standard deviation means that the pitch readings are spread out more widely, suggesting that there may be significant fluctuations or inconsistencies in your measurements. To improve the precision of your experiment, you could try to minimize external factors that might affect the pitch readings, such as vibrations or changes in the setup. Understanding this statistic helps you assess the reliability of your data and identify areas for improvement in your experimental design.
